overview_description.description: Established in 1997, United Finance Company (SAOG) is one of the leading finance companies operating in Oman. The company started its business with RO 5 million in the capital, one office at Muscat and 5 competitors, 4 being older than 10 years. Over the years, the company has established a niche market for itself in automobile financing and small and medium enterprises financing. The company has an asset base of RO 115 million, over 10,000 satisfied customers, 7 branches and 145 employees.

about_short_description.short_description: United Finance offers a wide range of financing products, corporate deposits and bancassurance for automobile, small and medium enterprises.

product.name: Vehicle Finance
product.description: Provides loans for purchasing vehicles including cars, fleets, boats, and used cars with competitive interest rates and flexible repayment periods.

product.name: Fleet Finance
product.description: Finances individual commercial vehicles or fleets like delivery vans, trucks, trailers, and buses for business logistics needs.

product.name: Heavy Equipment Finance
product.description: Offers loans for purchasing heavy construction equipment such as bulldozers, excavators, cranes, and industrial machinery.

product.name: Heavy Vehicle Finance
product.description: Provides financing for heavy commercial vehicles such as refrigerated trucks, container trucks, tippers, trailers, and tankers for transportation businesses.

product.name: Supply Chain Finance
product.description: Provides liquidity support to corporate clients and their vendors to improve cash flow and operational efficiency in supply chains.

product.name: Term Loans Finance
product.description: Offers customized term loans to businesses for capacity expansion, plant modernization, and other growth-related investments.
